You may be bothered by some questions “How to find my friends, find my family? Where to find my phone? How to locate my phone?”. Find Friends & Family is the answer to them, which acts as a mobile location tracker.

This family locator helps you to get notification when your family arrive in their destinations and check in. This friend finder helps you to find friends conveniently. Its location sharing feature keeps the people you love safe all time. It plays the role of position tracker to help you locate the person you want to locate.

Free to install Find Friends & Family, and it will help you to:

•  View real-time location with your family and your friends (or disable the location sharing if you don't want to);
•  Create circles on private maps as a family finder；
•  Join circles in this family locator/tracker；
•  Check in to notify people in circle that you arrived safely；
•  Get timely notifications when your family in circle check in by using this location sharing app；
•  Help you find your device (iPhone, iPad, Apple watch...) when you lost it;
•  View your own and other members' historical location tracks;
•  Send SOS notification to your circle members;
•  Share exact location with your family and your friends when you go hiking to ensure your safety;
•  Mark your favorite places on the map;
•  Have a private chat or group chat with your circle members;
•  Help you keep in touch with your kids;

As a location sharing app, Find Friends & Family help you to get connected and stay closer with your friends and family.

Find Friends & Family is able to find your family and friends and report where they are. Each member would appear on a private map with a unique icon after registration so that you can always know the real-time whereabouts of your family and friends. It is a truly friend finder and family locator which can enrich your life. Find Friends & Family can help you to check whether your children have arrived in school or home safely.

Find Friends & Family is an easy-to-use location sharing & tracking app. It protects the safety of your friend, family and helps you find your lost device.
